auditScope: Mutation Gate Integrity & EMPTY Hash Forensic Investigation

investigation.phenomenon: Logs from Phase 1 test suite exhibited records with before.geomHash='EMPTY' and after.geomHash='EMPTY'.

rootCauseAnalysis.mechanism: The mutation gate inspects doc.evaluatedShape. When a document is newly instantiated before initial feature execution, doc.evaluatedShape is null or undefined. Similarly, when a negative adversarial test supplies intentionally corrupted parameters (e.g., negative radius or invalid edge indices), parameter validation fails before shape generation. In both cases, computeGeometryHash returns 'EMPTY'.
rootCauseAnalysis.details: EMPTY hash reflects the uninitialized or non-evaluated state rather than a cryptographic hash collision or silent corruption. Fail-closed architecture halts pipeline prior to allocating unvalidated geometry.

mutationTests.name: Deterministic Hash Generation across Repeated Cycles
mutationTests.subject: Sphere(r=2.5m) and Torus(R=5.0m, r=1.5m)
mutationTests.details: Identical canonical inputs generate byte-identical geometry hashes across all runs with zero divergence.

mutationTests.name: Hash Mutation Sensitivity on Parameter Change
mutationTests.subject: Sphere radius delta (r=2.5m -> r=2.5001m)
mutationTests.details: Geometry hash changed from deterministic baseline to distinct cryptographic digest. Sensitivity threshold is within 1e-7.

mutationTests.name: Fail-Closed Immutability on Corrupt Feature Addition
mutationTests.subject: Fillet with non-existent edge ID 'edge_xyz_invalid'
mutationTests.details: Operation threw validation error; document feature tree and evaluated shape remained completely unaltered.

mutationTests.name: Rollback on Post-Execution Failure
mutationTests.subject: Shell with zero thickness
mutationTests.details: Mutation rejected at gate, previous valid evaluatedShape retained, preventing corrupted state persistence.

gateAssessment.limitationNoted: EMPTY hash should ideally be logged as 'STATE_UNINITIALIZED' or 'VALIDATION_REJECTED' to differentiate unbuilt documents from aborted mutations.
